name: distinct-includes-null
$comment: Distinct over an indexed optional string with absent values: rows without the field store SQL NULL in the f_tag column, and DISTINCT keeps one NULL row (README: NULL index values are included). Ordering derivation (verified live on the dev Postgres): the terminal projects SELECT DISTINCT to_jsonb(col) AS v ... ORDER BY v, so the absent-value row is SQL NULL and ASC uses the default NULLS LAST — strings first ascending, null last. (jsonb-type ordering would place 'null' BEFORE strings, which is why the fix decodes the SQL NULL cell as Option rather than COALESCEing the projection.)
